customAnalyses.description: Shows the latest collected completed attempt for recent main workflow runs. A workflow conclusion does not prove image publication, Kargo promotion, or deployment.
customAnalyses.name: CI release: Recent main workflow runs
customAnalyses.sql:
SELECT run_id, workflow_name, head_sha, event, conclusion, updated_at, duration_seconds, synced_at
FROM ci_audit.workflow_runs
WHERE head_branch = 'main' AND status = 'completed' AND updated_at >= now() - interval '7 days'
ORDER BY updated_at DESC, run_id DESC
LIMIT 100

customAnalyses.description: Shows recent classified job failures with the parent run's branch and revision. A job's duration is runner execution time when available, not queue time.
customAnalyses.name: CI release: Recent failed jobs
customAnalyses.sql:
SELECT j.job_id, j.run_id, j.workflow_name, j.job_name, j.runner_name, r.head_branch, r.head_sha,
  j.conclusion, j.failure_category, j.completed_at, j.duration_seconds, j.synced_at
FROM ci_audit.job_runs AS j JOIN ci_audit.workflow_runs AS r ON r.run_id = j.run_id
WHERE j.failure_category IS NOT NULL AND j.completed_at >= now() - interval '7 days'
ORDER BY j.completed_at DESC, j.job_id DESC
LIMIT 100

customAnalyses.description: Ranks observed job failure clusters in the 24-hour window ending at synced_at. Hides snapshots more than 15 minutes old; empty results are not proof that nothing failed.
customAnalyses.name: CI release: Top 24-hour failure clusters
customAnalyses.sql:
SELECT workflow_name, job_name, failure_category, occurrences_24h, sample_run_id, last_seen_at, synced_at
FROM ci_audit.failure_clusters
WHERE synced_at >= now() - interval '15 minutes'
ORDER BY occurrences_24h DESC, last_seen_at DESC, cluster_key
LIMIT 50

rules.description: For changes limited to CI orchestration, publishing, caching, timing reports, or Kargo controls, run workflow and script validation instead of rebuilding service images or starting unrelated test matrices. Rebuild the ARC self-hosted runner image when its embedded CI tools change.
rules.name: CI release: ARC runner and workflow inputs

provenance.verificationNote: docs/release-automation.md, Normal production path: runtime inputs and the embedded tool exception.

rules.description: Publish repo-owned immutable Kargo aliases only from reviewed main builds after required checks and the final multi-architecture OCI index succeed. Use kargo-sha-<40> or the run-qualified form for receipt-bearing builds, never latest or legacy sha-* tags. Preserve the external-publisher exceptions: analysis uses latest for discovery but pins the digest, and bilig uses the publisher's bare 40-hex tag.
rules.name: CI release: Main-only immutable publication

provenance.verificationNote: docs/release-automation.md, Artifact eligibility and Normal production path.

rules.description: Withhold every Warehouse-discoverable Kargo alias until all images, terminal validation, and artifact uploads succeed. Exclude preparation tags from Warehouse discovery. Read each retained build receipt from the selected Freight image's OCI annotations, not a Freight name or an inferred conclusion.
rules.name: CI release: Multi-image receipt gate

provenance.verificationNote: AGENTS.md, Infrastructure contracts: multi-image receipts and preparation tags. docs/release-automation.md, Artifact eligibility: selected-image annotations.

rules.description: Kargo alone promotes published images. Do not bypass it with SHA or digest bumps, release branches, deployment PRs, release automerge, or direct kubectl deployments. Operators must not create, retag, or manually select image aliases.
rules.name: CI release: No promotion bypass

provenance.verificationNote: AGENTS.md, Infrastructure contracts; docs/release-automation.md, Artifact eligibility and Normal production path.

rules.description: Use an exact automatic promotion policy for the matching Stage to select eligible Freight, not a broad selector. The receiving Argo CD Application must authorize that Stage with kargo.akuity.io/authorized-stage.
rules.name: CI release: Exact automatic Stage promotion

provenance.verificationNote: docs/release-automation.md, Normal production path and Application enrollment: exact Stage policy and authorization.

rules.description: The Stage checks out the exact source revision, writes the full promoted digest and build/provenance metadata to the renderer's inputs, and pushes the generated kargo/<stage> commit that Argo CD reconciles. ApplicationSet must preserve that branch and deployment metadata. Retained post-deploy checks follow that branch and the Stage-written paths, not main. Verify the rendered digest and the running revision and image, then exercise service-specific behavior.
rules.name: CI release: Generated deployment revision

provenance.verificationNote: docs/release-automation.md, Normal production path, Application enrollment, and Evidence.

rules.description: Keep credentials, including tokens, passwords, and connection strings, and personal data out of CI logs, job summaries, and artifacts. Retain enough sanitized evidence to identify the failing phase without exposing sensitive values.
rules.name: CI release: Secret-free evidence

provenance.verificationNote: AGENTS.md, Make the responsible change: useful error context without secrets or personal data. docs/release-automation.md, Normal production path: failing-phase evidence.

rules.description: Use ci_audit.workflow_runs.conclusion for the completed workflow outcome, not a job's outcome. Join ci_audit.job_runs to ci_audit.workflow_runs on run_id for branch and revision; do not treat matching jobs as part of the latest attempt.
rules.name: CI release: Workflow and job outcomes
rules.searchTerm: CI workflow outcome and job failures

rules.description: Read ci_audit.failure_clusters.occurrences_24h as of synced_at, not as a lifetime count or proof of release health. Use sample_run_id and the job's failure_category to investigate the underlying ci_audit.job_runs evidence.
rules.name: CI release: Failure cluster freshness
rules.searchTerm: CI recurring job failures in the last 24 hours
